description: Client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3: fixed LAN port in the World Options screen, changeable in-game

mods.name: LAN Port Default
mods.description: Pre-fills the LAN port field in the World Options screen with a fixed, configurable port, so a world is always shared on the same address.

releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric mod for **Minecraft 26.3**. MIT licensed.

Pre-fills the LAN port field in the World Options screen with a fixed, configurable port — so a world is always published on the same address, and the saved server entry of whoever joins never changes. The **DEF** button next to the field saves the port in the field as the new default.

### Install
1. Drop `lanport-default-fabric-26.3-1.2.4.jar` into `mods/` (Fabric loader 0.19.3+, Java 25).
2. First launch creates `config/lanport-default.properties` — default port is Minecraft's standard **25565**.
3. If the port is taken, the field is marked red by vanilla and you can type another one.

No blocks, no items, no commands, no networking, no Fabric API dependency.
